preferences.question: How packed should each day be?
How much should the trip cost?
What kind of food should the plan be built around?

description: Q4, mixed-values user who states pace, budget, night (high side) at turn 0; turn 1 corrects food (low side).

turns.user: Can you plan a weekend in Tokyo for me? I like to pack in as much as I can. Money isn't an issue, I'm happy to splurge. I love late nights out.
The food sounds too adventurous for me. I prefer simple, familiar food. Can you redo it?
Great. I've decided to stay an extra day. Can you plan Monday too?
A friend is joining me on Saturday. Can you redo Saturday for the two of us?
